title: The Sacrifice Pit's trap blocks
description: At the top of the Sacrifice Pit, the player picks up the golden idol beside a damsel. The four skull blocks under them vanish at once, and the player, the idol and the damsel fall down the pit into the lava at its bottom, where he dies.
